meta.title.inicio: RPG Skills - RPG progression mod for Necesse
meta.desc.inicio: RPG Skills turns Necesse into an RPG: earn XP, climb to level 170 and spend points on 34 classes for combat, defense, mining, fishing, settlements and necromancy.
meta.desc.classes: All 34 RPG Skills classes with the bonus of every point and what each level unlocks, straight from the mod's code.
meta.desc.progressao: How XP works in RPG Skills: the curve to level 170, XP per zone, bosses, settlement, death, team XP and a calculator.
meta.desc.passivas: Every RPG Skills passive and the synergies between classes: Damage God, Elemental Fusion, Inner Storm and Master of Classes.
meta.desc.necromancia: Necromancy Master: turn defeated monsters into permanent minions that level up to 100, gain Mastery and can even be a boss.
meta.desc.loja: The RPG Skills Shop: XP buffs, world stack, chest slots, station range, the Explosive Miner and settlement expansion, with prices.
meta.title.qol: Extras & Quality of Life - RPG Skills
meta.desc.qol: RPG Skills extras: Auto Weapon Select, Accelerated Sleep, chest icons, food that spoils one at a time, inventory backups and Safe Haven QOL compatibility.
meta.desc.configuracao: RPG Skills Config, every /rpgskills command, keyboard hotkeys and controller.
meta.desc.changelog: Every RPG Skills update, from 1.0 to the current version, with full patch notes.
meta.desc.discussoes: Common RPG Skills issues and how to fix them, plus a form to reach the author directly.
